_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'CONTRACTOR STATUS REPORT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.03.

f01_Contractor.label: Contractor
f01_Contractor.guidance: The legal name and contact details of the contractor performing the contract.

f02_Contract_Number_and_Type.label: Contract Number and Type
f02_Contract_Number_and_Type.guidance: The official contract identifier and contract type (e.g., Fixed Price, T&M).

f03_Reporting_Period.label: Reporting Period
f03_Reporting_Period.guidance: The start and end calendar dates covered by this contractor report.

f04_Report_Submission_Date.label: Report Submission Date
f04_Report_Submission_Date.guidance: The exact date on which the report was officially submitted to the project manager.

f05_Scope_Status_This_Period.label: Scope / Status This Period
f05_Scope_Status_This_Period.guidance: Assessment of contracted scope deliverables completed or in progress during this period.

f06_Scope_Variance_and_Cause.label: Scope / Variance and Cause
f06_Scope_Variance_and_Cause.guidance: Explanation of any deviations from contracted scope baselines and their root causes.

f07_Quality_Status_This_Period.label: Quality / Status This Period
f07_Quality_Status_This_Period.guidance: Evaluation of deliverable quality against contracted standards and specifications.

f08_Quality_Variance_and_Cause.label: Quality / Variance and Cause
f08_Quality_Variance_and_Cause.guidance: Root causes and details of any non-conformance or failed quality checks.

f09_Schedule_Status_This_Period.label: Schedule / Status This Period
f09_Schedule_Status_This_Period.guidance: Assessment of progress against contracted milestone dates and schedule baselines.

f10_Schedule_Variance_and_Cause.label: Schedule / Variance and Cause
f10_Schedule_Variance_and_Cause.guidance: Root cause explanation for any schedule delays or accelerations.

f11_Cost_Status_This_Period.label: Cost / Status This Period
f11_Cost_Status_This_Period.guidance: Assessment of contract billings and expenditures against the financial plan.

f12_Cost_Variance_and_Cause.label: Cost / Variance and Cause
f12_Cost_Variance_and_Cause.guidance: Root cause explanation for any financial variances or billing discrepancies.

f13_Estimated_Completion_Date_Estimate.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f13_Estimated_Completion_Date_Estimate.label: Estimated Completion Date / Estimate
f13_Estimated_Completion_Date_Estimate.guidance: The contractor projected delivery and contract completion date.

f14_Estimated_Completion_Date_Basis.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f14_Estimated_Completion_Date_Basis.label: Estimated Completion Date / Basis
f14_Estimated_Completion_Date_Basis.guidance: Basis and rationale supporting the estimated completion date.

f15_Estimated_Final_Cost_Estimate.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f15_Estimated_Final_Cost_Estimate.label: Estimated Final Cost / Estimate
f15_Estimated_Final_Cost_Estimate.guidance: Projected total final cost at completion (applicable to cost-reimbursable contracts).

f16_Estimated_Final_Cost_Basis.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f16_Estimated_Final_Cost_Basis.label: Estimated Final Cost / Basis
f16_Estimated_Final_Cost_Basis.guidance: Basis and historical cost rate data supporting the estimated final cost.

f17_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Estimate.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f17_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Estimate.label: Key Forecast Assumptions / Estimate
f17_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Estimate.guidance: Summary of key assumptions underpinning forecast values.

f18_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Basis.section: Forecast Performance for Future Reporting Periods
f18_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Basis.label: Key Forecast Assumptions / Basis
f18_Key_Forecast_Assumptions_Basis.guidance: Dependencies and external conditions supporting forecast stability.

f19_Claims_or_Disputes.label: Claims or Disputes
f19_Claims_or_Disputes.guidance: Summary of any new, pending, or resolved contractual claims or disputes.

f20_Risks.label: Risks
f20_Risks.guidance: Key vendor-side risks that could impact contract milestones or deliverables.

f21_Planned_Corrective_or_Preventive_Act.label: Planned Corrective or Preventive Action
f21_Planned_Corrective_or_Preventive_Act.guidance: Specific remedial actions planned by the contractor to recover performance variances.

f22_Issues.label: Issues
f22_Issues.guidance: Current active roadblocks, technical issues, or dependencies affecting execution.

f23_Escalations.label: Escalations
f23_Escalations.guidance: Items requiring urgent decisions or dispute intervention from the buyer or PMO.

f24_Contract_Change_Requests.label: Contract Change Requests
f24_Contract_Change_Requests.guidance: Summary of formal contract change proposals submitted, reviewed, or pending.

f25_Comments.label: Comments
f25_Comments.guidance: Additional context, contractor remarks, or explanatory notes.
